projects.title: Untitled Rocketry
projects.description: Founded and lead a 10-member competitive rocketry team that qualified for nationals in the American Rocketry Challenge. The team is responsible for designing, building, testing, and launching rockets that meet specific mission requirements while staying within strict constraints.
accomplishments: Built rockets from materials to flight

projects.title: Modular Rocket System
projects.description: Designed and 3D-printed a fully modular rocket system that adapts to different flight conditions, payloads, and environmental factors. The system uses standardized components and quick-connect mechanisms for rapid assembly and testing.

projects.title: Telemetry Lost
projects.description: Designed and built a text-based RPG game based on book Mickey 7 by Edward Ashton. The game features a branching narrative, multiple endings, and a unique combat system that combines strategy and chance.
accomplishments: Learned about java and game development
